status: PROPOSAL — supersedes engagement_disposition.json. Erik's correction, and it is the moralising bias inverted.

theCorrection.erik: 'you're labeling the word pacifist onto a lot of people. Just because some traditions are all about peace doesn't mean they haven't figured out ways to resolve things, or even USE FORCE TO KEEP THE PEACE. A stillhold pacifist might end up on the battlefield and convince some NOT to fight — or to actively stop fights. They would also make GREAT GUARDS for this reason — they have high skill. So it's the WAY they do the deeds that changes, for the most part, not that they wouldn't engage at all.'
theCorrection.myError: ⚠️ I READ 'PEACE TRADITION' AS 'DOES NOT PARTICIPATE' and set `engages: 0.15` — the lowest in the world — then argued it was 'not a nerf, it is the tradition.' It was a nerf, and it was the moralising bias inverted: instead of rewarding virtue I made virtue ABSENT. Same root — I decided what a people would want to do instead of reading what their craft does.
theCorrection.theCraftsSaidSo: Their own crafts contradict me and I quoted them while missing it. `step_between` is MOVING INTO THE MIDDLE OF VIOLENCE. `the_held_breath` holds 'a moment where violence is TOTAL'. `calm_word` talks someone down FROM THE EDGE. `the_price_shown` HINDERS. **These are all battlefield crafts.** A Stillhold figure is not absent from the fight — THEY ARE STANDING IN IT.

fix1_engagementIsMethodNotRate.principle: ⚠️ `engages` WAS THE WRONG DIAL. Nearly every tradition engages at a similar rate; what differs is WHAT A WIN LOOKS LIKE. Split it in two.
fix1_engagementIsMethodNotRate.engages: how often a figure enters a confrontation at all. RAISE THE FLOOR — most traditions sit 0.9-1.3. Very few are genuinely rare.
fix1_engagementIsMethodNotRate.resolutionMode: ⚠️ THE NEW DIAL, AND THE REAL ONE. What this figure's victory IS.

modes.force: the opponent is beaten. marcher, blazeborn, unmaker, abyssal, somatic.
modes.prevention: ⚠️ THE FIGHT DOES NOT HAPPEN. stillhold, numinous, threnodist. A PREVENTED FIGHT IS A WON CONTEST — same weight, different narration.
modes.proof: the opponent is shown to be wrong and cannot proceed. verist, syllogist, cogitant, lattice.
modes.removal: the opponent is no longer where the problem is. umbral, veilwright, horizon.
modes.endurance: the opponent stops first. mason, hourkeeper, ashwarden, rootkin.

fix1_engagementIsMethodNotRate.stillholdNote: ⚠️ STILLHOLD GOES 0.15 → 1.1 — ABOVE AVERAGE. They are on the field constantly; their crafts are all about being present where violence is. What makes them Stillhold is `resolutionMode: prevention`: their contest win is A FIGHT THAT DID NOT HAPPEN, and it scores exactly what a kill scores.
fix1_engagementIsMethodNotRate.andTheyShouldGUARD: Erik: 'they would also make GREAT GUARDS — they have high skill.' `guardIntercept` is already weight 3 and `step_between` is literally the craft. GIVE STILLHOLD A GUARD PREFERENCE, not a fighting penalty — they should be over-represented in the guard pool, which makes them deed-rich by the route their tradition actually uses.

fix2_theHoldingStreak.erik: 'a streak of holding could give an edge... something that builds to a point. It would get dropped down if interrupted.'

mechanic.name: heldTheLine
mechanic.accrual: holding the SAME care across consecutive passes builds a streak counter
mechanic.edge: the streak adds to the figure's push on that arc — +10% per consecutive pass
mechanic.cap: ⚠️ BUILDS TO A POINT: caps at +50% (5 passes). A long hold is strong, not unbounded.
mechanic.interruption: ⚠️ DROPS ON INTERRUPTION — if the figure spends a pass elsewhere, or is wounded off the front, the streak falls. Erik: 'it would get dropped down if interrupted.'
mechanic.dropMode: RESET TO ZERO on abandoning the care; HALVE on being driven off (wounded/struck). Losing a front you were forced off is not the same as leaving it.
mechanic.deed: ⚠️ AND IT PAYS: crossing 5 consecutive passes credits `heldTheLine` at weight 3 — the same as a contest won, because HOLDING A FRONT FOR FIVE PASSES IS THE MECHANIC THAT MOVES ARCS and nothing was paying for it.

fix2_theHoldingStreak.whyThisFixesTheRealGap: The deed ledger had seven sources, six combat-shaped, and the only non-combat one (`heldThroughCrisis`, weight 1) fires ONLY when holding COST YOU YOUR PERSONAL TIME — you were paid for sacrifice, never for work. Meanwhile `applyEpicArcPush` shows that LEANING is what actually moves arcs, every pass, for every figure. THE LEDGER REWARDED THE AMPLIFIER AND IGNORED THE ENGINE. `heldTheLine` pays the engine.
fix2_theHoldingStreak.andItIsNotAPACIFISTCONSOLATION: ⚠️ IMPORTANT, per DIRECTIVE_SNG-280: this is not a peaceful-figure prize. A marcher who holds one front for five passes earns it identically. It rewards CONSTANCY, which is available to everyone and characteristic of nobody in particular — and the figures who chase every fire will never have it, which is the trade.
